description: This Java interface defines a builder for creating responses and events related to deleting feature definitions in a live command context within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes nested factory interfaces for producing command responses and events upon executing delete operations.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building responses and events related to delete feature definition commands, including nested factories for responses and events.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses (success, inaccessible error, not modifiable error) for delete feature definition commands.

classes.name: DeleteFeatureDefinitionLiveCommandAnswerBuilder.EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating delete feature definition events, specifically the FeatureDefinitionDeleted event.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a successful DeleteFeatureDefinitionResponse or FeatureDefinitionDeleted event.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition was not accessible.

methods.name: featureDefinitionNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates an error response indicating the feature definition was not modifiable.
